speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Joan. Anne asked me one thing at the brook, and I gave her three answers. If thou seest her, tell her I heard how it sounded.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Tell her yourself. I am not a lane between two houses.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is only that I heard it.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Then the hearing will keep till thou walkest to her. Spend the afternoon in thine own voice.
